hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';const c=i.tool_input?.new_string||i.tool_input?.content||'';if(p.endsWith('CLAUDE.md')&&/^(##|\*\*).*?(마지막 작업|과거 작업|직전 작업|현재 진행 상황|과거 세션 \(세션|\(세션 \d+)/m.test(c)){console.error('BLOCKED: CLAUDE.md 진행 박제 금지 (.claude/rules/planning.md L43). 메모리 활용: ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/session{N}_summary.md');process.exit(2);}" < /dev/stdin

node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const i=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=(i.tool_input?.file_path||'').replace(/\\/g,'/');const m=p.match(/frontend\/src\/lib\/((?:transfer-tax|property-tax|acquisition-tax|brokerage|area)[^/]*)\.ts$/);if(!m||p.includes('__tests__'))process.exit(0);const fname=m[1]+'.ts';try{const a=fs.readFileSync(path.resolve('.claude/ASSETS.md'),'utf8');if(a.includes(fname))process.exit(0);console.error('BLOCKED: 신규 계산기 lib '+fname+' 생성 시 .claude/ASSETS.md §2 표 갱신 필수 (drift 차단). 한 줄 추가 후 재시도.');process.exit(2);}catch(e){console.error('WARN: ASSETS.md 읽기 실패 '+e.message);process.exit(0);}" < /dev/stdin

node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=(i.tool_input?.file_path||'').replace(/\\\\/g,'/');if(/backend\/.*\.py$/.test(p)){const rel=p.replace(/.*\/backend\//,'');try{cp.execSync('ruff check '+JSON.stringify(rel),{cwd:'backend',stdio:'pipe'});}catch(e){console.error('[PostToolUse 자동검증] ruff 경고 — '+rel+':\n'+(e.stdout||e.stderr||'').toString().slice(0,1500));}}else if(/frontend\/.*\.tsx?$/.test(p)&&!/\.d\.ts$/.test(p)){console.error('[PostToolUse 리마인더] frontend TS 변경 — 커밋 전 `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` 실행 권장 (전체 tsc 는 느려서 hook 자동실행 제외).');}process.exit(0);" < /dev/stdin
